reviewBoundary: Newly authored provisional primary-school text practices. Exact answer evidence and every distractor were checked by the author only; this is not independent teacher review, learner calibration, an official examination or publication approval.

materials.title: Museum Headphones 008
materials.text: At the museum, use the small headphones with a blue dot. The big ones are for adults. Turn the sound down before you put them on. Do not share your pair while you wear it. If you hear nothing, ask the helper. Return your pair to the blue tray.

questions.prompt: A friend chooses the big headphones. You say, "____"
options: Use the small pair with a blue dot.
questions.explanation: A儿童按蓝点小耳机；B成人大耳机不合分配；C杯子不是耳机。

questions.prompt: A friend is about to put on loud headphones. You say, "____"
options: Put them in your lunch bag.
questions.explanation: B先调低音量；A提高与要求相反；C饭袋非使用步骤。

questions.prompt: A friend wants to wear one side of your pair while you wear the other. You say, "____"
options: Yes, let us share this way.
questions.explanation: C不共戴一副，另用本人耳机；A违共戴规则；B拉线无关。

questions.prompt: A friend hears nothing. You say, "____"
questions.explanation: A无声求助；B拆开、C丢弃均非规定处理。

questions.prompt: The visit is over. A friend asks where the headphones go. You say, "____"
questions.explanation: B归蓝盘；A成人袋、C雨中都非回收处。

materials.title: Egg Carton Farm 008
materials.text: We help pack eggs at the farm. Use clean, dry cartons. Put one egg in each hole. A cracked egg goes on the red plate for the farmer to check. Keep full cartons flat. Write today’s date on the lid, not on the eggs.

questions.prompt: A friend finds a wet carton. You say, "____"
questions.explanation: A要求干净干盒；B湿盒不符；C水里不是装盒位置。

questions.prompt: A friend puts two eggs in one hole. You say, "____"
options: Put one egg in each hole.
Close the carton with no eggs.
questions.explanation: B每孔一枚；A再加更违规则；C空盒关闭不能完成包装。

questions.prompt: A friend finds a cracked egg. You say, "____"
options: Put it on the red plate.
questions.explanation: C裂蛋红盘待农户检查；A隐藏、B衣袋均不合分流。

questions.prompt: A friend tips a full carton on its side. You say, "____"
questions.explanation: A满盒平放；B摇、C倒置均不符合要求。

questions.prompt: A friend writes the date on an egg. You say, "____"
options: Write it on the farmer’s shirt.
questions.explanation: B日期写盖不写蛋；A重复错误；C衣服非标记位置。

materials.title: Long Vowels Playground 008
materials.text:
Match the vowel sound in each word in capitals and choose a word to complete the sentence. Use each bank word once. Bank: A. plate B. home C. slide D. huge E. nine
1. Jane (JANE) puts her cake on a ____1____.
2. Joe (JOE) says, "School is over. Let us go ____2____."
3. The white (WHITE) playground has a long ____3____ to go down.
4. The cute (CUTE) toy elephant is very big. It is ____4____.
5. I like (LIKE) the number after eight. It is ____5____.

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 1?
questions.explanation: A plate与JANE均/eɪ/且可放蛋糕；B home /əʊ/、C slide和E nine /aɪ/、D huge /juː/均不合目标元音与餐具义。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 2?
questions.explanation: B home与JOE均/əʊ/且go home放学回家合义；A plate /eɪ/、C slide和E nine /aɪ/、D huge /juː/不合元音及搭配。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 3?
questions.explanation: C slide与WHITE均/aɪ/且可滑下；E nine同音却是数字不能是可滑设施；A plate /eɪ/、B home /əʊ/、D huge /juː/均不合。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 4?
questions.explanation: D huge与CUTE均/juː/且意为巨大的；A plate /eɪ/、B home /əʊ/、C slide和E nine /aɪ/均不合读音与形容体积的语法。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 5?
questions.explanation: E nine与LIKE均/aɪ/且八后是九；C slide同音非数字；A plate /eɪ/、B home /əʊ/、D huge /juː/均不合。

materials.title: Toast And Timer 008
materials.text: Dad makes toast for breakfast. I put plates on the table. My sister gets two cups. We do not touch the hot toaster. Dad sets a timer for the eggs in the pot. When it rings, he takes the eggs out. I think the sound is the doorbell and run to the door. There is no one there. Dad laughs and shows me the little timer.

questions.prompt: The writer puts plates on the table.
questions.explanation: A正确：I put plates on table；B否认分工。

questions.prompt: The sister gets three cups.
questions.explanation: B正确：two cups；A把二改为三。

questions.prompt: The children touch the hot toaster.
questions.explanation: B正确：do not touch；A忽略禁止与否定。

questions.prompt: Dad uses a timer for the eggs.
questions.explanation: A正确：sets timer for eggs；B否认计时用途。

questions.prompt: Someone is waiting outside when the writer opens the door.
questions.explanation: B正确：no one there，声音来自计时器；A把误认当事实。

units.title: 有凸起线条的校园地图

materials.title: City Map Raised Lines 008
materials.text: Our school makes a map with raised lines. Visitors can feel the lines with their fingers. A smooth circle marks the main hall, and a rough square marks the library. The maker first puts both shapes too close together. Some visitors cannot tell them apart. She moves them farther apart and adds a key beside the map. A pupil reads the key aloud for visitors who want help. The school keeps the old paper map too, so people can choose the kind that works for them.

questions.prompt: Visitors can feel the raised lines with their fingers.
questions.explanation: A正确：feel lines with fingers；B否认触摸使用方式。

questions.prompt: A rough square marks the main hall.
questions.explanation: B正确：粗方块标图书馆，光滑圆标大厅；A交换形状地点。

questions.prompt: The first two shapes are too close together.
questions.explanation: A正确：too close导致难区分；B否认初始问题。

questions.prompt: The maker removes the key from the new map.
questions.explanation: B正确：adds a key是增添；A把添加说成移除。

questions.prompt: The school keeps the old paper map available.
questions.explanation: A正确：keeps old paper map too；B与提供选择相反。

materials.title: Film Club Bank 008
materials.text:
Choose from the shared bank. Use each word once. Bank: A. quietly B. before C. borrow D. screen E. Friday
Our film club meets every ____1____, the day before Saturday. We check the room ____2____ the film starts, not after it ends. We close the curtains so the picture on the ____3____ is clear. Pupils may ____4____ a cushion from the basket if their chair feels hard. During the film, everyone speaks ____5____ so others can hear the story.

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 1?
questions.explanation: E Friday为周六前一天；A安静地、B之前、C借、D屏幕均非星期名。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 2?
questions.explanation: B before与not after对应；A方式副词、C借、D屏幕、E星期均不能连接film starts表达先后。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 3?
questions.explanation: D screen显示影片画面；A副词、B介词、C动词、E星期不表示显示画面的物体。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 4?
questions.explanation: C borrow可借靠垫；A quietly、B before、D screen、E Friday均不作may后所需借用动作。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 5?
questions.explanation: A quietly修饰speaks且不影响他人听；B before、C borrow、D screen、E Friday均不表示说话方式。

units.title: 纸船比赛前的两次测试

materials.title: Paper Boat Race Test 008
materials.text: For a paper-boat race, our group first chose the widest boat because it looked strong. During a test in the sink, it carried six small counters without sinking. A narrow boat carried only four. We thought the choice was easy. Then our teacher reminded us that the race would be along a shallow channel with moving water. In the channel, the wide boat kept touching the sides and stopped. The narrow boat moved farther even with a lighter load. We changed our plan. We kept the sink results in our notes, but we chose the narrow boat for the race. We did not claim that it could carry more weight; it was simply more useful for this course.

questions.prompt: The group first preferred the widest boat.
questions.explanation: A正确：first chose widest；B否认最初偏好。

questions.prompt: The narrow boat carried more counters in the sink test.
questions.explanation: B正确：宽船六、窄船四；A把载重优势交换。

questions.prompt: The race course had moving water.
questions.explanation: A正确：shallow channel with moving water；B否认比赛条件。

questions.prompt: The wide boat moved freely without touching the sides.
questions.explanation: B正确：宽船kept touching sides and stopped；A与实测相反。

questions.prompt: The group chose the narrow boat because it suited the course better.
questions.explanation: A正确：窄船走更远，结尾更适用本赛道；B否认改选理由。

units.title: 周末社团的三张活动卡

materials.title: Weekend Club Cards 008
materials.text:
Weekend activity cards
A. Map Makers: Saturday 9:00–10:30, Room 5. Draw a walking map of the school. Bring a pencil. Suitable for pupils who enjoy careful measuring. No computers needed.
B. Story Voices: Saturday 10:00–11:00, music room. Read a short story aloud in pairs. Bring a water bottle. You do not have to sing.
C. Mini Gardens: Sunday 9:30–11:00, covered yard. Plant herbs in reused containers. Bring an empty, clean food tub. Soil and seeds are provided.
All activities are free. Book one place at the office by Thursday. A parent may collect a booking form, but the pupil must choose the activity.

questions.prompt: Which activity involves measuring?
questions.explanation: B地图社适合精细测量；A朗读无测量要求；C种植未提测量；D无三者同等测量依据。

questions.prompt: What must a pupil bring to Mini Gardens?
questions.explanation: C自带净空食物容器；A土种已供；B电脑非需；D乐器无关。

questions.prompt: Which two activities overlap in time?
questions.explanation: A周六10至10:30重叠；B和C跨周六周日不重叠；D否认明确重叠。

questions.prompt: When must places be booked?
questions.explanation: D周四前办公室预约；A周日、B周六后、C活动中均超过要求。

questions.prompt: What may a parent do?
options: Choose an activity without the pupil.
questions.explanation: B家长可取表；A活动须学生选；C全部免费且种子提供；D无改期权限。

units.title: 植物园出发前的五个确认

materials.title: Botanic Trip Questions 008
materials.text:
Before a visit to the botanic garden, pupils ask the trip leader five practical questions. Match each question with the best answer. Each bank answer is used once.
A. Yes, but only on the marked path.
B. Because the glasshouse is warmer than outside.
C. At the visitor desk beside the gate.
D. Please bring a notebook and a pencil.
E. It leaves at half past two.

questions.prompt: Are we allowed to walk around the pond?
options: Yes, but only on the marked path.
Because the glasshouse is warmer than outside.
At the visitor desk beside the gate.
Please bring a notebook and a pencil.
It leaves at half past two.
questions.explanation: A允许但限标记路，回应许可；B原因、C位置、D携带物、E发车时间都不直接回答是否可绕池走。

questions.prompt: Why should we take our coats off inside the glasshouse?
options: Yes, but only on the marked path.
Because the glasshouse is warmer than outside.
At the visitor desk beside the gate.
Please bring a notebook and a pencil.
It leaves at half past two.
questions.explanation: B室内较暖解释脱外套原因；A步道许可、C问讯台、D物品、E时间均不答Why。

questions.prompt: Where can we get a printed garden map?
options: Yes, but only on the marked path.
Because the glasshouse is warmer than outside.
At the visitor desk beside the gate.
Please bring a notebook and a pencil.
It leaves at half past two.
questions.explanation: C大门旁服务台答领图地点；A行走限制、B温度原因、D所带工具、E发车时间都不答Where。

questions.prompt: What do we need for recording the plants?
options: Yes, but only on the marked path.
Because the glasshouse is warmer than outside.
At the visitor desk beside the gate.
Please bring a notebook and a pencil.
It leaves at half past two.
questions.explanation: D笔记本与铅笔适合记录；A许可、B温度、C位置、E时间不能回答记录用品。

questions.prompt: What time does our return bus leave?
options: Yes, but only on the marked path.
Because the glasshouse is warmer than outside.
At the visitor desk beside the gate.
Please bring a notebook and a pencil.
It leaves at half past two.
questions.explanation: E两点半发车回答时间；A路径、B原因、C服务台位置、D用品都不答What time。

units.title: 校服交换日的尺寸标签

materials.title: Uniform Swap Tags 008
materials.text:
At the school uniform swap, families donated clean clothes they no longer needed. Volunteers checked each item and wrote its size on a plain tag. They removed old name labels before displaying the clothes. The event was free, and families could take an item even if they had nothing to donate.
The first layout grouped clothes by colour. It looked tidy, but parents had to search through several tables for one size. After an hour, volunteers regrouped them by size and added a small colour marker to each tag. This kept colour information without making it the main sorting rule. A sign said that sizes on old labels could vary, so pupils should try items on in the screened area. Volunteers counted the clothes taken, but they did not record which family needed which size.

questions.prompt: A family had to donate an item before taking one.
questions.explanation: B正确：没有可捐物也可领取；A把免费交换加上捐赠前置条件。

questions.prompt: Old name labels were removed before the clothes were displayed.
questions.explanation: A正确：移除旧姓名后展示；B否认隐私处理。

questions.prompt: The original colour-based layout made finding one size difficult.
questions.explanation: A正确：需多桌搜索同尺码；B否认更改布局的原因。

questions.prompt: After regrouping, the tags no longer showed any colour information.
questions.explanation: B正确：保留小颜色标记；A把主排序改尺码误作删除颜色信息。

questions.prompt: The organisers counted items taken without recording each family’s size needs.
questions.explanation: A正确：计件但不录哪家何尺码；B混淆数量统计与个人需求记录。
